title: Learning to Be Truncated: Preparing LLM Checkpoints for SVD Compression
abstract: arXiv:2611.34667v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Compression based on singular value decomposition (SVD) often requires subsequent fine-tuning or weight correction to mitigate performance degradation. Budget-specific optimization must be repeated for different compression ratios. We introduce LLift, which prepares a pretrained model for SVD compression across ratios without further fine-tuning. LLift fine-tunes a low-rank approximation at a single ratio using the original model as a teacher. We merge the learned updates into the original weights while preserving the complementary components excluded from the training forward pass. We apply SVD to the prepared model's target matrices and reuse the decompositions at different truncation ranks. On LLaMA-7B, we demonstrate accuracy gains across three compression ratios using a single prepared model. The gains extend across model families, model sizes, and SVD compression operators. translated_title: 学会被截断：为大语言模型检查点做好SVD压缩准备
translated_abstract: 基于奇异值分解（SVD）的压缩通常需要后续的微调或权重校正来缓解性能下降问题，而针对特定压缩预算的优化必须针对不同压缩比率重复进行。我们提出了LLift，它能够使预训练模型为跨多种压缩比率的SVD压缩做好准备，而无需进一步的微调。LLift以原始模型作为教师，在单一比率下微调一个低秩近似。我们将学习到的更新合并到原始权重中，同时保留在训练前向传播中被排除的互补组件。随后我们对准备好的模型的目标矩阵应用SVD，并在不同的截断秩下复用这些分解结果。在LLaMA-7B上，我们仅使用一个准备好的模型就在三个压缩比率下展示了准确率的提升。这些提升可推广至不同的模型家族、模型规模以及SVD压缩算子。我们通过分析梯度和早期训练更新来提供（对该方法有效性的）解释。
tldr: 提出LLift方法，仅需在单一压缩比率下用原模型作为教师进行一次低秩微调，即可将预训练大语言模型检查点准备好，使其在多种SVD压缩比率下直接获得准确率提升，无需针对每个比率重复微调。
en_tdlr: LLift prepares LLM checkpoints for SVD compression through a single teacher-guided low-rank fine-tuning at one ratio, enabling accuracy gains across multiple compression ratios without further fine-tuning.
